author: Elijah Jero
name: BotSheild
description: Provides bot protection features including captcha verification for new members and scam detection for suspicious messages. Helps protect your server from automated bots and potential scams.
install_msg: BotSheild cog loaded. Use [p]botsheild protect to set up server protection with captcha verification.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild protection settings, captcha verification state, and scam-detection configuration. Message content may be scored in memory for scam detection.
